notes: chat/completions: SSE `data: {chat.completion.chunk}`, choices[].delta, tool args accumulate by index, terminates `data: [DONE]`; opt in to usage via stream_options.include_usage=true.
responses: NAMED SSE events (response.created ... response.output_text.delta ... response.completed), NO [DONE] sentinel; tools are FLATTENED {type:function,name,description,parameters,strict}.
Some newer models are Responses-only -> /v1/responses is a SECOND full stream+tool translator (v1/v2 scope decision Q4).
